LINCOLN HIGHWAY AREA
CURRENT REAL ESTATE AREA
AVAILABLE AND REPLACEMENT
PROPERTIES SURVEY
FALL AND WINTER 1975
A. Houses
As there is only one house that may be affected by this improvement, and considering the fact that the house is typical to the area, it is obvious that the market can easily absorb this displacee. A cursory search located over 75 available existing replacement houses with a range from the low twenties to the upper forties and over 50 homes soon to be constructed starting in the upper thirties.
B. Apartments
There is only one apartment building potentially involved in right-of-way take. Even though the tenants of this apartment building were not interviewed nor contacted, information on the types of apartment units involved was available and used in our search for adequate rental replacement dwellings. Chicago Heights and the south suburban area are rich in existing apartments. In terms of new development, several complexes are springing up rapidly in the vacant parts of the area, although most of these feature rentals higher than our subject building.
To accommodate the 33 units that may be displaced by this taking, we have located over 150 available existing replacement apartments. The range for these apartments vary from $125 to $300 per month. These were found in classified advertisements and through signs on buildings. Furthermore, we learned from our sources that many apartments are advertised by word of mouth and that people looking for units generally find what they want rather quickly.
C. Commercial
It seems likely that all but one or two of the seven commercial units will be reconstructed and continue operation after a partial taking. If any have to be relocated, present conditions and trends indicate that adequate replacement will be available. A drive through the area revealed several suitable replacement stores and offices for rent, and those persons in the area with whom the improvement of Lincoln Highway has been discussed have indicated there are numerous locations in the general area for commercial establishments to continue viable business.
